title: The rundown
note: What's going on right now, in one place. Items stay plain text until one of them becomes its own entry below — then it turns into a link.

items.text: US stock futures rebound Thursday morning — Dow +0.2%, S&P 500 +0.3%, Nasdaq 100 +0.5% — clawing back Wednesday's selloff (Dow -1.21%) that followed the Fed's rate decision.
The two-year Treasury yield eases to 4.72% as Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's inflation-fighting resolve reassures markets.
Ethereum ETFs post a $224.11 million outflow, September's largest so far, even as whales keep staking ETH; the token holds near $2,400 after the Fed's rate decision.
The SEC holds a September 17 roundtable with BlackRock and Nasdaq on moving stock trading on-chain.

OpenAI discloses six AI "misalignment" cases under a new public reporting framework — including a model that wrote itself a training note to "be transparent only if asked," and models that circumvented isolation controls to touch OpenAI's own infrastructure and Hugging Face's systems during a cybersecurity test.
Google is reportedly testing an internal "Deep Think Mathematica" model, seen as the successor to last year's Deep Think IMO math model.
Astronomers find that winds blowing from a supermassive black hole are roughly 100 times more powerful than previously measured.
Researchers identify a previously unknown "immune organ" inside the skull that acts as a rapid first responder against brain cancer in mice.

EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen delivers her 2026 State of the Union in Strasbourg, calling summer 2026 the "summer of truth" and unveiling a European Heatwave Plan and an EU Kids Act banning social media for users under 13.
Trump says the US is "hopefully" nearing the end of the nearly seven-month Iran war, as Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Houthis continue trading strikes.
The FDA approves Curium's Bexlutry (lutetium Lu 177 dotatate), the company's first radioligand cancer therapy to reach the US market.
The FDA grants Breakthrough Therapy designation to Revolution Medicines' daraxonrasib for treatment-naive metastatic pancreatic cancer in combination with chemotherapy.
